carried_findings.finding: Container basis crashes the whole batch instead of being refused per case. iso/natural_window.py:202 `if basis not in BASIS_REGISTRY:` forces a hash evaluation on an unhashable value, so a list or dict basis raises TypeError: unhashable type: 'list' / 'dict'. The 14-case run_cases.py gate therefore aborts with SUT raw_returncode=4 and never writes sut_report.json, while the frozen expectations for H5 (basis=['union_of_windows']) and H6 (basis={'kind':'union_of_windows'}) demand per-case {"verdict":"reject_claim","refusals":["R-BASIS-UNKNOWN"]}. Those two expectations are CURRENTLY UNSATISFIABLE. r1 (495a4411...) silently accepted both (verdict=accept_claim, refusals=[]) - an over-permissive accept.
carried_findings.evidence: In-process probe against both SUTs: iso -> TypeError at iso/natural_window.py:202 (traceback-extracted line and source line confirmed) for list and dict; r1sut -> accept_claim/refusals=[] for list, dict and set. Set ({'union_of_windows'}) is hashable and already reaches R-BASIS-UNKNOWN, so the crash is list/dict-specific, not container-general.
carried_findings.disposition: REGISTERED as plan-side card I-14-I (PLAN/execution_v2/card_I-14-I.md). The xfail in harness/test_i14h_natural_window.py:183-190 RECORDS the residual only; it does NOT satisfy it.
carried_findings.required_followup: Add a type guard (e.g. isinstance(basis, str)) before the membership test so unregistered containers are refused per case with R-BASIS-UNKNOWN; freeze expectations for list/dict/set/tuple plus a negative control on a registered string basis; drop the xfail; re-run the FULL 14-case run_cases.py gate to rc 0 (mismatch_count=0, accepted_ineligible=0) and land cases_report.json in the I-14-H attempt evidence directory.
